note: Feature-truth inventory for the docs rebuild (phase 9.1). `evidence` points at the file that implements the feature; a feature with no evidence is absent, not shipped. `shortcuts` labels match src/opencanvas/presentation/v2/v2Shortcuts.ts exactly; `ops` names match src/agent/manifest.ts exactly; `families` names match src/dsl/ast.ts DSL_FAMILIES. inventory.test.ts enforces all of that.

features.name: The editor shell
features.notes: One page: canvas plus floating chrome (document bar, creation toolbar, workspace rail, context bar, panels).

features.name: Document bar
features.notes: Rename, save status, pages, export, open file, canvas menu, agent connect.

features.name: Workspace rail
features.notes: Five modes: AI assistant, Architecture model, Slides, Diagram as code, Connect agent.

features.name: Settings
features.notes: Appearance light/dark/system, density, dot grid, snap to grid, canvas colour.

features.name: Saved preferences
features.notes: Preferences persist in localStorage, validated field by field. Not account-synced; there are no accounts.

features.name: Autosave with conflict detection
features.notes: Saves to IndexedDB; a write that loses the version race reports conflict with a reload action.

features.name: Crash recovery
features.notes: A corrupt primary record falls back to the last good copy; corrupt-with-no-fallback surfaces a diagnostic download.

features.name: Local-first storage
features.notes: IndexedDB only. No server, no account, no sync.

features.name: Open a .json file
features.notes: Canonical JSON any supported schema version; opening saves a fresh id so it never overwrites the source.

features.name: V1 file import
features.notes: One-shot: a legacy { nodes, edges } file is projected onto the 2.0 document model.

features.name: Keyboard shortcuts
features.notes: The map is data; v2Shortcuts.test.ts checks it against the dispatcher.

features.name: Shift+1 label in the shortcut map
features.notes: The map labels Shift+1 "Zoom to 100% (Shift)" but the dispatcher (useV2Keyboard.ts:195) runs fit-view for Shift+1 and reset-zoom for ⌘1. The generated docs page corrects the row and names the discrepancy; the source label is the thing to fix (src/ is read-only in phase 9).

features.name: Shortcut cheatsheet (?)
features.notes: Rendered from the shortcut map, not typed twice.

features.name: Select and Hand tools
features.notes: Pointer state machine: select, box-select, drag, pan.

features.name: Pan and zoom
features.notes: Zoom to cursor; wheel and pinch normalised. Keyboard zoom targets fit / selection / 100%.

features.name: Touch gestures
features.notes: Two-finger pinch/pan, double-tap, long-press context menu. No touch-specific layout; desktop chrome on a tablet.

features.name: Selection
features.notes: Click, shift-click, box-select and lasso all feed one selection store.

features.name: Hover handles and drag-to-connect
features.notes: Four side handles on hover; dropping on empty canvas quick-creates a connected shape with its label open.

features.name: Rectangle, ellipse and 42 shapes
features.notes: SHAPE_OPTIONS is the 42-entry library behind the Shapes flyout.

features.name: Connector tools
features.notes: Arrow (direct, the default), elbow (orthogonal), curve (bezier), line (direct, no head), path (click-by-click polyline).

features.name: Text tool
features.notes: Click to place text; double-click a shape edits its label.

features.name: Chart insertion
features.notes: Ten kinds: table, quadrant, bar, line, area, scatter, pie, donut, radar, heatmap.

features.name: Pen and highlighter
features.notes: Pressure/tilt-aware freehand strokes stored as node input samples.

features.name: Eraser
features.notes: Drag collects the strokes it crossed; one undo step.

features.name: Lasso
features.notes: Polygon drag selects every node whose box it touches.

features.name: Icon library
features.notes: Search over the shipped icon packs; the pick inserts an icon node.

features.name: Emoji picker
features.notes: Static catalogue with search and recents; emoji are inserted as text.

features.name: Image insertion
features.notes: File picker or pasted URL; bytes live in the asset store, the node keeps the id.

features.name: Move and nudge
features.notes: Arrow keys move 1 px, Shift+arrow 10 px, as one command per gesture.

features.name: Resize
features.notes: Eight handles; Shift locks aspect; Alt resizes from the centre.

features.name: Rotate
features.notes: Rotation handle outside the corner; Shift snaps to 15°.

features.name: Snapping and alignment guides
features.notes: Object and grid snapping with guides; ⌘/Ctrl while dragging bypasses snapping.

features.name: Undo and redo
features.notes: One history entry per user intent; every command has an inverse.

features.name: Copy, cut and paste
features.notes: In-app clipboard over serialized nodes and connectors.

features.name: Copy and paste style
features.notes: ⌘/Ctrl+Alt+C / V applies node or connector appearance to the selection.

features.name: Duplicate
features.notes: ⌘/Ctrl+D duplicates the selection with fresh ids.

features.name: Delete and unplace
features.notes: Backspace deletes; on a model view it unplaces the element instead, keeping the model entry.

features.name: Remove from model
features.notes: Deletes the model element itself; offered in the model panel and context menu.

features.name: Z-order
features.notes: Forward/backward (⌘]) and front/back (]); group variant moves the whole selection.
shortcuts: Bring to front / send to back

features.name: Lock and unlock
features.notes: Locked nodes ignore move, resize and the agent move op.

features.name: Group and ungroup
features.notes: ⌘/Ctrl+G wraps in a container; Shift+G unwraps one level.

features.name: Bold, italic and underline
features.notes: Toggles apply to the selected text nodes.

features.name: Edit label
features.notes: Enter or F2 opens the in-place label editor; double-click does the same.

features.name: Context menu
features.notes: Right-click a shape, connector, frame or empty canvas for actions; includes Edit as code on frames.

features.name: Selection context bar
features.notes: Floats over the selection with the actions and styles that apply to it.

features.name: Fill, stroke, width, dash, opacity
features.notes: Node and connector style panels over the style node commands.

features.name: Layers panel
features.notes: Page tree with visibility and lock toggles.

features.name: Chart data panel
features.notes: Edits chart data by writing the DSL source back through Edit as code.

features.name: Multi-page documents
features.notes: Add, rename, duplicate, reorder and delete pages; the document bar names the active page.

features.name: Align and distribute
features.notes: Align edges/centres on Alt+A/D/W/S/H/V; distribute on Alt+Shift+H/V.

features.name: Flip
features.notes: Mirrors the selection around its own centre.

features.name: Diagram as code panel
features.notes: Edit DSL, live diagnostics, ⌘↵ Generate, palette picker, canvas-edited warning.

features.name: The OpenFlow DSL
features.notes: Version 1 line-oriented grammar with per-line warnings; bad lines are dropped, not fatal.

features.name: Parser and diagnostics
features.notes: One parse feeds the panel diagnostics and the compile.

features.name: DSL serialization and round-trip
features.notes: serialize(parse(text)) == text is enforced by the round-trip corpus.

features.name: Generate and regenerate a frame
features.notes: Code lands as one frame; regenerating replaces it as one undo step.

features.name: Edit as code
features.notes: Right-click a generated frame to reopen its source; ⌥D opens the panel.

features.name: Mermaid import
features.notes: Detected in the code panel and converted with a loss report; unsupported constructs are listed, not silently dropped.

features.name: Structurizr import
features.notes: Structurizr DSL pasted into the code panel converts to an architecture workspace.

features.name: Flowchart family
features.notes: Default family; nodes, edges, groups, notes, alignment statements.

features.name: Architecture family
features.notes: Icon-backed architecture diagrams plus the C4 workspace (model/views/flows/deployment).

features.name: Sequence family
features.notes: Participants, messages, activations and fragments.

features.name: State family
features.notes: States, composite states, fork/join/choice.

features.name: ERD family
features.notes: Entities, fields and cardinality.

features.name: Class family
features.notes: Classes, members and relations; shares the structured-family engine with ERD.

features.name: Mindmap family
features.notes: One central node with indentation-defined branches.

features.name: Gitgraph family
features.notes: Commits, branches, merges, tags and cherry-picks.

features.name: Chart family
features.notes: One chart per diagram; kinds match the chart tool.

features.name: Browser and mobile frame nodes
features.notes: Reachable through the DSL shape words `browser` and `mobile`; the app draws the frame chrome. The SVG/PNG export draws them as plain labelled cards. The wireframe widget library is separately absent.

features.name: Quadrant axis and region labels in the DSL
features.notes: `x:`, `y:` and `quadrants:` lines never match: the family compares the space-joined statement text against `x:`, so the lines are reported as invalid points (W131) and ignored. The quadrant chart itself and its `Label [x, y]` points are shipped; labels are fixed defaults.

features.name: Reserved families (bpmn, org, gantt, wireframe, sankey, journey, timeline)
features.notes: Reserved names parse to a flowchart with warning W105. Wireframe is explicitly unbuilt (phase 6.7).

features.name: Architecture model panel
features.notes: Element tree derived from placed nodes; select, drill in, edit, remove.

features.name: C4 element views and drill-down
features.notes: Breadcrumb chain, child views, Enter to open the element view.

features.name: Architecture edits
features.notes: Edit element metadata, create child views, open flow as sequence.

features.name: Flow playback
features.notes: Steps through a flow on the canvas, arrow keys/space, dimming the rest.

features.name: Tag perspective
features.notes: Matching elements stay bright, the rest dims; one tag set per document preference.

features.name: Workspace folder
features.notes: File System Access API only (Chrome/Edge): architecture.ofk + views/*.snap + adr/*.md, written back to disk. Not git-aware beyond plain files.

features.name: animate block
features.notes: Family-neutral `animate <preset> [duration] { step ... }` block; steps become a timeline.

features.name: Animation export panel
features.notes: Preset/order/duration/size/fps controls, live preview, animated SVG download, GIF/MP4/WebM encode, clipboard copy where supported.

features.name: PNG and SVG export
features.notes: Selection/page/document scope, light/dark/print theme, transparency, 1–3× scale.

features.name: PDF export
features.notes: PDF is the browser print dialog over the exported SVG, not a file written directly.

features.name: Canonical JSON export
features.notes: Whole document, every page; the same bytes `openflow_save` writes.

features.name: GIF, MP4 and WebM export
features.notes: Encoded in a worker; MP4/WebM need WebCodecs and are hidden when unavailable.

features.name: Light and dark themes
features.notes: System default with an explicit override; exports offer light/dark/print separately.

features.name: Diagram palettes
features.notes: pastel (default), paper, builder, mono; an `appearance:` line in the DSL wins over the panel.

features.name: MCP operation surface
features.notes: One MCP tool per op, generated from this registry. Live mode runs ops in the paired editor; file mode runs them over an open .openflow.json.

features.name: MCP capability manifest
features.notes: Every op names the human operation it mirrors and the equivalence test.

features.name: MCP document tools
features.notes: openflow_create, openflow_open, openflow_save, whoami.

features.name: MCP DSL validation
features.notes: Runs the real parser and returns its diagnostics.

features.name: MCP codebase analysis
features.notes: Deterministic local scan that suggests architecture elements.

features.name: MCP starter templates
features.notes: Five DSL starting points (auth-flow, three-tier-architecture, request-sequence, order-state, event-pipeline).

features.name: MCP architecture discovery
features.notes: discover_architecture derives elements from the repository; explain_element adds descriptions and linked ADRs.

features.name: MCP drift report
features.notes: Matches by element name and tech only; it cannot see intent, renames or moved code.

features.name: Agent pairing (live bridge)
features.notes: Local long-poll bridge on a configurable port with an optional shared token.

features.name: Agent activity panel
features.notes: Shows what the connected agent did, with per-action details.

features.name: BYOK AI generation
features.notes: Ten providers over three wire formats; the key stays in the browser. Provider specifics are frozen until phase 10 lands (CSP still omits some endpoints).

features.name: AI proposal review
features.notes: The model's DSL is compiled, shown for review, then accepted as one undo step or discarded.

features.name: AI prompt builder
features.notes: Injects the canonical grammar and the current frame's DSL into every request.

features.name: No account, no telemetry in the app
features.notes: No analytics SDK in dependencies and no telemetry calls under src/. The docs site is separate and its analytics are opt-in at build time.

features.name: Canvas performance
features.notes: The headed polish probe measures drag latency, idle rendering and context-bar tracking. No committed 2k-object 60 fps benchmark; phase 7 measured 500 nodes × 451 frames at 3.1 s wall.

features.name: Collaboration, share links, room IDs, viewer counts
features.notes: Removed in phase 0 with yjs; nothing in src/ mentions collaboration, share links, rooms or viewers.

features.name: Infrastructure sync
features.notes: src/services/infraSync was deleted in phase 0 and nothing replaced it.

features.name: Flowpilot
features.notes: No occurrence of the name anywhere under src/.

features.name: GitHub embed
features.notes: No embed surface; export is files and clipboard.

features.name: Frame presets and presentation tools (phase 6.6)
features.notes: Unbuilt: phone/tablet/window frame presets, the laser pointer and the sticky-note tool. DSL browser/mobile frame nodes and the `note` sticky kind are separately shipped.

features.name: Wireframe widget library and family (phase 6.7)
features.notes: Unbuilt; `wireframe` stays a reserved family that parses as a flowchart.

features.name: Slides and Present mode (phase 8)
features.notes: The rail shows a Slides panel whose buttons are disabled and whose content is placeholder; nothing is saved.

features.name: Keyframe tracks and timeline panel (phase 8)
features.notes: Motion steps are text; there are no per-object curves, ruler or keyframes.

features.name: Film look / cinematic rendering (phase 7b)
features.notes: On hold by owner decision; no renderer code exists.

features.name: Command center / launcher
features.notes: No command palette or launcher exists in the 2.0 editor.

features.name: Diagram diff and compare
features.notes: No baseline/snapshot comparison in the editor or MCP surface.

features.name: Named snapshots and version restore
features.notes: Storage keeps one primary plus one fallback record for crash recovery; there is no named-version history.

features.name: SQL / OpenAPI / Terraform import
features.notes: No such importers; the only foreign syntaxes are Mermaid and Structurizr.

features.name: Figma design import
features.notes: No Figma API client or design-system import; Figma appears in the code only as a UX convention.

features.name: Rule-based architecture linting
features.notes: lintDsl returns parser diagnostics; there are no JSON rule packs or canvas violation highlighting.

features.name: Design system theme import/export
features.notes: Four fixed diagram palettes plus the UI token set; no user-managed design systems.

features.name: Hand-drawn stroke style
features.notes: Stroke styles are solid/dashed/dotted; the rough/hand-drawn renderer was V1 and is gone.

features.name: Re-layout the canvas with ELK
features.notes: ELK runs inside DSL compile only; there is no command that re-lays-out hand-placed canvas nodes.
